authored_representative_side: Left knee crosses outside the right distal thigh; right palm hugs the left knee; left hand supports behind.
interpretation: One representative side of seated half spinal twist. Start seated with legs extended and a small support-compatible knee bend; cross the left foot outside the right distal thigh, place the left palm behind, hug the left knee with the right hand/arm, and gently rotate across Spine/Spine1/neck. The5s2/1/2 demo is authored; source workout hold20–30s and repeat the opposite side remain separate. Actual pelvic skin, extended heel, crossed sole and rear central palm are supported.
